newsitem.title: USA: CBS edges out NBC in weekly Nielsen ratings.
newsitem.headline: CBS edges out NBC in weekly Nielsen ratings.

text.p: CBS defeated NBC in the weekly television ratings survey by one-tenth of a rating point in the week ended May 11, Nielsen Media Research said.

CBS was led by its Sunday night presentation of "Mario Puzo's The Last Don," which finished third, behind NBC's top-ranked "ER" and "Seinfeld," but ahead of NBC's "Fired Up" and "Friends," Neilsen said.
CBS, a unit of Westinghouse Electric Corp., posted 10.1 rating points for the week, compared with NBC's 10.0 points, said Nielsen, which is a unit of Cognizant Corp..
Both figures translated into a 17 percent share, based upon an average of all the television sets tuned in during prime time.
Rating points are a measurement of the percentage of the 97 million U.S. households with television sets.
Walt Disney Co.'s ABC finished third with 8.3 points or a 14 percent share. ABC's top ranked show, "Home Improvement" finished eighth, Nielsen said.
News Corp.'s Fox posted 7.1 rating points and a 12 percent share for the week, Nielsen said.
Trailing for the week were Time Warner Inc.'s WB and Viacom Inc.'s UPN with 2.4 points and 3.0 points, respectively.
